description: Implementation of NamespaceReadPlatformService that interacts with a database to retrieve namespace data by ID or prefix, using Spring's JdbcTemplate and a custom RowMapper.

classes.name: NamespaceReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that provides methods to retrieve NamespaceData objects from the database based on ID or prefix.

classes.name: NamespaceMapper
classes.description: Inner static class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to NamespaceData objects.

methods.name: retrieveNamespaceById
methods.description: Retrieves NamespaceData by the given ID from the database.

methods.name: retrieveNamespaceByPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves NamespaceData by the given prefix from the database.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string used as the base for namespace queries.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from the SQL result set to a NamespaceData object.
